name: XDKNet 3.0.3.1
body:
XDKNet 3.0.3.1 is a small fix to 3.0.3.0. Update the server plugin to
3.0.3.1 along with the app.

## Fixed

- How to watch guides read the same on the sign-up page as in the editor's
  preview: code or bold text of exactly 500 characters, and a link of
  exactly 2100, were formatted in the preview but shown as plain text on
  the page.

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the Android TV APK below.
